summary: A pull_request run's evidence gate, and the signed-only list and other base-read policy, come from the first parent of the checked-out merge instead of the payload's base.sha, which a reopen or ready_for_review leaves stale; a signed-only opener's run whose payload base is outside that history is refused

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema change. The decision line gains an event_base field after base.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. What a note must satisfy is unchanged; only which base commit the gate is read from changes for pull_request runs.

compatibility.detail: Merge groups and pushes are unchanged. A pull_request run whose payload base is current is unchanged.

manual.detail: None. Until this lands, do not reopen our pull requests or mark them ready_for_review.
